society.skycraft.say.whiterun.1: Grain carts from Rorikstead have been queuing at the main gate since daybreak.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.2: The Wind District smells of elder-blossom whenever the breeze comes off the Gildergreen.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.3: You can hear the Skyforge hammer ringing all the way down in the Plains market.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.4: Gray-Mane and Battle-Born cousins used to drink at the same hearth before the war split the hold.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.5: Watch your purse by the caravan tents outside the gate; the road traders drive a hard bargain.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.6: Jarl Balgruuf keeps his banners flying while both armies glare across the White River.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.7: Riverwood rafts floated another forty pine logs down the gorge this morning.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.8: If you need a blade tempered before dark, speak to the smiths by the inner gatehouse.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.9: Pilgrims bound for the Seven Thousand Steps always stop at the Bannered Mare for dry boots.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.10: Every barrow along the northern tundra has been restless since the autumn frosts set in.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.11: Honningbrew casks are scarcer this month, though the tavern cellars still have a few reserve kegs.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.12: Cloud Districtfolk look down from the stone steps as if the lower stalls did not feed their tables.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.13: Our watchtower sentries spotted smoke rising behind the western crags at dusk.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.14: White River meltwater runs cold enough to numb a horse's fetlocks by mid-afternoon.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.15: The Companions hall turns no one away who can heft a shield and keep an honest oath.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.16: Barley yields out by Pelagia's fields beat every other hold south of the Pale.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.17: Proventus still tallies every sack of flour that crosses the drawbridge before noon.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.18: Take the cobbled road past the meadery if you want to reach the river ferry before nightfall.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.19: Priests of Kynareth tend the wounded in the temple long after the market lanterns go out.
society.skycraft.say.whiterun.20: Tundra wolves have been trailing the mammoth herds closer to the western road than usual.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.1: East Empire brigs anchored two deep below the great stone arch before the tide turned.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.2: Legion drums echo off Castle Dour's courtyard walls from dawn inspection until evening muster.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.3: You can tell a Bards College student by the ink on their cuffs and the lute case on their back.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.4: Salt wind off the Sea of Ghosts rusts an ungreased hinge faster than anywhere else in Skyrim.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.5: Dragon Bridge timber wagons pay their toll at the stone lions before climbing the ridge road.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.6: Blue Palace petitioners wait hours on the polished flagstones just for three words with the steward.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.7: The Temple of the Divines keeps eight altars lit, though one alcove sits noticeably bare.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.8: Warehouse clerks down at the docks measure every crate of spiced wine twice before signing.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.9: Thalmor carriages roll up the mountain track toward their summit compound behind closed curtains.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.10: Fletchers and tailors along the Avenue charge Imperial prices for anyone wearing a clean cloak.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.11: Keep your lantern steady on the coast rocks; the Broken Oar shoals have claimed better hulls than ours.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.12: Sawmill blades across the bay scream day and night cutting fir planks for the navy yards.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.13: High King Torygg's name still brings a hush whenever someone raises a horn in the Winking Skeever.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.14: Cliffside gulls nest in the old windmill rafters whenever a northwest squall blows in.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.15: Steward Falk Firebeard knows every patrol schedule between the Karth delta and the lighthouse.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.16: Fishermen haul silver cod from the estuary channels before the harbour ice thickens.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.17: Nobody lingers near the headsman's block by the gate once the afternoon bell has rung.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.18: Imported Cyrodilic cloth fills the upper stalls while dockhands patch canvas down by the pilings.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.19: Solitude's lighthouse beacon cuts through three leagues of sea fog when the braziers are stacked high.
society.skycraft.say.haafingar.20: Imperial couriers change horses at the Four Shields Tavern without even stopping for hot broth.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.1: Mist clings to the headstones here until midday, even in the height of summer.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.2: Runil tends more graves than living parishioners, yet he remembers every family name on the stones.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.3: Pine resin and wet sawdust hang over the creek from Half-Moon Mill all the way to town.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.4: Since Helgen burned, the mountain pass to Cyrodiil has been choked with fallen masonry and ash.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.5: Hunters on the southern ridges pray to the old woodland spirits when the town gates are shut.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.6: Lake Ilinalta looks calm from the shore, but cold currents pull beneath the sunken ruins.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.7: Young Jarl Siddgeir prefers spiced venison and Cyrodilic wine to listening to border petitions.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.8: Old Dengeir still mutters in the longhouse corner about plots hatched in Imperial counting-houses.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.9: Carpenters in Falkreath never lack work; between coffins and watchtowers, the saws never cool.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.10: Stay on the blazed trail through the tall spruces unless you fancy meeting a spriggan in the fern.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.11: Bandit lookouts have been squatting in the old border forts ever since the garrison pulled back.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.12: Arkay's lantern burns blue above the Hall of the Dead whenever a fresh burial wagon arrives.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.13: Fishermen out by the western coves pull lake-trout heavy as iron ingots from the reed beds.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.14: Every family in the valley has at least one ancestor buried under the mossy yews on the hill.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.15: Blacksmiths here forge more felling axes and skinning knives than parade swords.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.16: Dead Man's Drink stays warm long after dusk when the woodcutters come in from the wet timber.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.17: Wolves in the southern pines hunt in larger packs than the tundra strays up north.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.18: Herb-gatherers collect nightshade and mora tapinella from the rotting stumps behind the cemetery.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.19: Travelers crossing from Hammerfell used to fill the inn yard before the border roads grew dangerous.
society.skycraft.say.falkreath.20: Moss grows thick on the north side of every cabin roof before the planks are even seasoned.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.1: Step off the cedar boardwalks after dark and the peat bog will take your boot to the knee.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.2: Jarl Idgrod's ravens seem to know who is coming down the marsh causeway before the guards do.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.3: Swamp fungal pods and deathbell grow thick along the channels for anyone brave enough to wade.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.4: Folks in Morthal bolt their shutters early when the pale mist rolls off the Hjaal river.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.5: Falion walks out toward the stone circles at midnight, though nobody asks him what he meets there.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.6: The charred timbers of the burnt house by the water still make the neighbors uneasy.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.7: Stonehills miners haul iron ore out of the rock ridge where the dry ground finally begins.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.8: Chaurus clicks in the reed beds sound just like dry branches snapping until they are too close.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.9: Our sawmill keeps the town fed; marsh cypress resists rot better than any highland pine.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.10: Neither Legion nor Stormcloak quartermasters care much for a hold where wagons sink to the axle.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.11: Moorside Inn keeps a peat fire smoldering day and night to drive the damp from our cloaks.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.12: Eels and mudcrabs from the brackish channels fill half the stewpots in Hjaalmarch.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.13: Ancient Nordic cairns jut out of the fen like broken teeth above the black water.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.14: Lami brews marsh-fever tonics from swamp-fungal caps for every woodcutter on the wharf.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.15: Will-o'-the-wisps drift over the northern pools whenever the wind drops dead.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.16: Gorm watches the Highmoon Hall doors with his hand on his axe hilt from dusk till cockcrow.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.17: Flat-bottomed punts are worth more than horses once the spring thaws flood the lower causeway.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.18: Travelers bound for Solitude hurry past our torches as if the fog itself had teeth.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.19: Young Joric inherits his mother's strange sight, though it weighs heavily on the boy.
society.skycraft.say.hjaalmarch.20: Keep a torch lit on the Hjaal road; the frostbite spiders spin webs between the bog willows.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.1: Two mines at opposite ends of Dawnstar and still the foremen argue over every ingot.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.2: Nobody in the harbour has slept a clean, dreamless night since the early snows began.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.3: Quicksilver vapour from the lower shafts leaves a metallic taste on the wind when the gale shifts.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.4: Jarl Skald wants every able spear in the Pale marched south for Ulfric's campaign.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.5: Brina Merilis fought in the Great War and knows how thin Dawnstar's defences really are.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.6: Ice-floes grind against the harbour pilings loud enough to wake the whole waterfront.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.7: Nightgate Inn sits fifty leagues from anywhere, yet its hearth has saved many a frozen courier.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.8: Priest Erandur climbed toward the old tower on the peak, muttering prayers to Mara.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.9: Horker bulls sun themselves on the shingle spit just beyond the longboat slipways.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.10: Frida's mortar never stops grinding; half the miners need sleeping draughts before they can work.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.11: Ore coasters load iron bar at Dawnstar quay whenever the pack ice opens a channel.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.12: Giant camps down on the southern heath have been driving their herds near Loreius Farm.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.13: Windpeak Inn smells of boiled whale-oil lamps, wet wool, and strong spiced ale.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.14: Blizzards sweep down from the Sea of Ghosts so fast you can lose the road between two fenceposts.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.15: Iron-Breaker miners swear the deep seams are warmer than the cottages up on the shelf.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.16: Old sea-captains at the wharf still trade tales of wrecks pinned in the northern ice-pack.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.17: Anga's Mill cuts frozen spruce logs where the Pale road climbs toward Windhelm.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.18: Guard your ears against frostbite if you take the high pass past Weynon stones.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.19: Even the Khajiit caravans pitch their tents close to the smithy fires when they stop at Dawnstar.
society.skycraft.say.the_pale.20: White Hall's banners snap so hard in the north gale that the weavers mend them every week.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.1: Golden birch leaves carpet every road in the Rift, though the woods hide more than deer.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.2: Nothing moves on Lake Honrich or through the city gates without Maven Black-Briar hearing of it.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.3: Keep to the upper plankwalks in Riften unless you have business down in the canal vaults.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.4: Black-Briar Meadery vats perfume the whole eastern quarter with fermented honey and cloves.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.5: Fishermen on the wooden piers haul silver-scale perch out of the lake before the morning mist lifts.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.6: Weddings at the Temple of Mara bring travelers from every hold, war or no war.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.7: Balimund feeds his forge with fire salts so the steel holds an edge through winter damp.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.8: Ivarstead sits at the foot of the great mountain, where every pilgrim stops to catch their breath.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.9: Shor's Stone miners have been fighting frostbite spiders down in Redbelly Mine all week.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.10: Goldenglow's apiaries buzz across the island while armed mercenaries pace the stone causeway.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.11: Jarl Laila speaks of rooting out the Thieves Guild, though her own steward smiles too politely.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.12: Heartwood Mill saws golden birch planks for every boatbuilder on Honrich's shore.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.13: Largashbur's palisade gates stay barred while the Orc clan wrestles with a giant's curse.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.14: Smugglers use the old lakeside ruins to slip Morrowind brandy past the south gate toll.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.15: Children at Honorhall Orphanage peer through the iron fence whenever market wagons roll past.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.16: Sarethi Farm grows jazbay grapes and nirnroot in the sheltered loam below the mountains.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.17: Bears in the autumn birchwoods grow bold when the salmon run up the Treva.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.18: The Bee and Barb gets crowded at sundown when dockhands, merchants, and cutpurses share the benches.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.19: Frostmir's early freeze never reaches the Rift valleys until the last birch leaf has fallen.
society.skycraft.say.the_rift.20: Mistveil Keep's watchtowers look out over the eastern passes toward the Velothi border.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.1: Half of old Winterhold lies at the bottom of the sea, yet the College towers didn't budge an inch.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.2: Scholars cross the narrow stone bridge with their noses in books while the town shivers below.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.3: You can see the Shrine of Azura's great star against the clouds from five leagues down the coast.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.4: The Frozen Hearth is the only warm room between the ruined bluff and the Whistling Mine.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.5: Jarl Korir sits in a half-empty longhouse remembering when Winterhold rivaled Solitude.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.6: Birna sells whatever salvage washes up from the broken cliffs or old coastal shipwrecks.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.7: Apprentice mages light the bridge braziers with spells, and townsfolk cross to the other side of the street.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.8: Whistling Mine's shaft howls like a banshee whenever the northeast gale hits the mountain face.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.9: Sea-ice hunters out on the northern shelves track horkers and snow bears by the aurora's glow.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.10: Even a Thalmor advisor walks the College halls now, watching the mages over his high collar.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.11: Crumbled gable walls along the cliff edge drop another stone into the surf every spring thaw.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.12: If you need enchantments or rare scrolls, the Arcanaeum up in the College holds centuries of ink.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.13: Amol's ruined watch-hamlet down by the river ford sees more soldiers than travelers these days.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.14: Ice wraiths dart through the snowdrifts along the pilgrim track whenever the moon is pale.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.15: Townsfolk blame the Great Collapse on magic, though the sea had been gnawing that chalk cliff for ages.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.16: Nelacar conducts his own experiments in the inn's back room since leaving the College.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.17: Keep your hood laced tight on the road from Dawnstar; the wind off the glaciers cuts through leather.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.18: Pilgrims climbing to Azura's altar leave offerings of moonstone and silver by the brazier steps.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.19: Urag gro-Shub guards his ancient volumes fiercer than any Jarl's housecarl guards a throne.
society.skycraft.say.winterhold.20: On clear nights the aurora turns the snowfields green and violet from the sea stacks to Saarthal.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.1: Windhelm's grey stone walls were raised in Ysgramor's age and still shrug off every winter storm.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.2: Steam rises from the southern hot springs while the northern harbour freezes solid around the hulls.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.3: Candlehearth Hall rings with old Nord battle-songs whenever Ulfric's veterans come off watch.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.4: Dunmer shops in the Gray Quarter keep their lanterns burning late despite the cold stares on the street.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.5: Argonian dockworkers haul cargo in the freezing slush outside the river wall from dawn till dark.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.6: Kynesgrove miners cut green malachite from the volcanic seams beneath the sacred birch grove.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.7: Palace of the Kings has seen twenty generations of rulers carved into its great hall pillars.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.8: Darkwater Crossing sits where the warm mineral pools meet the cold mountain gorge.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.9: Mixwater Mill's waterwheel never freezes thanks to the steaming vents upstream.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.10: Narzulbur's Orc smiths smelt ebony ore pulled from Gloombound Mine across the wooden bridge.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.11: Guard patrols have been doubled in the Stone Quarter after the latest talk of a prowler at night.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.12: Talos priests preach openly in Windhelm's courtyard with no Imperial legate to silence them.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.13: Volcanic flats south of the city smell of sulphur and boiled clay after every rain.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.14: Clan Cruel-Sea and Clan Shatter-Shield have run the northern shipping lanes for three lifetimes.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.15: White Phial's signboard still swings by the market square, where Nurelion studies his old formulas.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.16: Giants herd their mammoths across the warm sulfur basins where the tundra grass stays green.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.17: Longboats bound for Solstheim tie up at the outer wharf below the snow-covered battlements.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.18: Farmsteads outside Windhelm's bridge battle early frost every harvest to fill the granaries.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.19: Braidwood Inn at Kynesgrove serves hot ash-yam stew brought over the Velothi pass.
society.skycraft.say.eastmarch.20: Even the bridge stones leading into Windhelm are worn smooth by centuries of iron-shod boots.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.1: Every house in Markarth is carved straight into the Dwemer cliff; even the beds are cut from stone.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.2: Silver-Blood guards watch the smelter gates closer than the Jarl's men watch the high road.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.3: Cidhna Mine prisoners swing picks in the dark so the treasury coffers never run dry.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.4: Wait on a canyon trail after dusk and you'll see Forsworn bone-totems hanging from the junipers.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.5: Waterfalls roar through Markarth's terraces loud enough to drown out any whisper on the steps.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.6: Karthwasten's silver veins belong to Reachfolk miners, though mercenary companies keep circling the valley.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.7: Calcelmo has spent half a lifetime cataloguing the brass gears ticking beneath Understone Keep.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.8: Old Hroldan Inn boasts a bed where Tiber Septim slept after storming the Reachman ramparts.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.9: Dibella's gilded temple sits high on the cliff above the smoke of the Warrens.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.10: Dushnikh Yal and Mor Khazgur trade iron and Orichalcum across the crags without asking the Jarl's leave.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.11: Soljund's Sinkhole miners swear the lower shafts break into an older Nordic crypt.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.12: Keep your eyes on the high ledges when riding the Karth gorge; an arrow drops faster than a rockslide.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.13: Bothela's Hag's Cure smells of juniper berries, crushed bone-meal, and mountain heather.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.14: Bronze pipes in the city walls still carry steam from boilers lit before the First Era.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.15: Silver-Blood Inn serves travellers on stone benches while the family factors count bullion upstairs.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.16: Kolskeggr's gold veins drew prospectors until the Briarhearts claimed the gorge above the bridge.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.17: Labourers in the Warrens sleep in damp stone alcoves a hundred steps below the noble terraces.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.18: Goats and juniper bushes are the only things that thrive on these vertical limestone crags.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.19: Shrine of Talos tucked beneath the cliff stairs still draws quiet visitors when the Justiciars look away.
society.skycraft.say.the_reach.20: Smelter smoke hangs in the lower canyon every morning until the river wind sweeps the gorge.
